note: TC-233 NI-01..NI-12, NI-15..NI-24, NI-30..NI-36 and NI-38..NI-40 (FR-322 "Operand index segments"). Each case is an RFC 6902 patch over the base package, whose operand rows are [[], [], [0], [0]]. NI-30..NI-36 and NI-38..NI-40 are read with fixtures/positive-dependency-library.json supplied as the direct dependency test/predicates (19 nodes); a case with supplied also supplies it under each identity listed there. A schema of invalid fails the V2 schema and is malformed_wire at the patched member (locus); a schema of valid passes it and the reader's operand checks refuse malformed_wire, with no cause, at locus, before every semantic_graph check, unless expected names another outcome: passes_operand_checks (NI-24), passes_operand_and_duplicate_checks (NI-22), passes_operand_checks_with_dependency_position (NI-30), or a later refusal at locus (NI-23). NI-13 (the deep chain), NI-14 (the copied id), NI-25..NI-29 (request-style documents and the composition clause check) and NI-37 (a library clause node added) are built by the test, not published.
